item.title: Google Analytics 4 1.17.4 - Server-Side Consent, Bot Filtering and Better Ad Matching
item.description: Google Analytics 4 for Magento 2 version 1.17.4 is now available, along with Marketing Suite PRO and all nine server-side Conversions API addons. It adds a server-side consent gate honouring Consent Mode v2, bot filtering with a merchant-editable user agent list shared by every integration, anonymous matching for guest visitors, and utm and gclid capture into first-party cookies. It also fixes an identifier data loss in the OpenAI Ads addon. New features ship disabled by default.

item.title: OpenAI Ads Conversion Tracking for Magento 2 - New Server-Side Addon
item.description: The OpenAI Ads Conversions API Addon for Magento 2 is now available. It sends PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, Purchase and Signup events from your Magento server directly to OpenAI's Conversions API, bypassing ad blockers and browser tracking prevention for more accurate campaign measurement in ChatGPT's advertising platform. Requires Google Analytics 4 PRO 1.17.3 or higher, and is included at no extra cost in the Marketing Suite PRO bundle.
